findings: Packets hash-bind bundle/catalog/source files and compare frontier identity, scope, state, status and receipt membership. They remain derived views.
Source commit strings are descriptive; source bytes are verified but commits are not resolved. Acceptance contract IDs are recorded strings rather than registry admission.

Accepted/refutation outcomes require declared PASS, artifact digest strings and complete named mutation refusals. The module does not execute a verifier, resolve returned artifact bytes or verify receipt contents.
Without prior_ledger, existing attempt input receives the current packet fingerprint after the packet changes. Explicit prior binding blocks this drift.

Direct overlay accepts an old ledger against changed packet content with the same packet ID; it does not compare attempt fingerprint or packet-set binding. CLI rebuilds both, with separate reads; no concurrent CLI race executed.

Prior preservation compares normalized records by ID and sorts attempts by ID; it establishes set extension under explicit prior binding, not chronological prefix or unconditional append-only persistence.
Verification debt counts pending outcomes, not unresolved proof obligations or all historical failed/unverifiable returns.
proposed_repairs: Require attempt input to name its exact packet fingerprint; refuse stale identity instead of assigning the current one.
Check packet-set and per-attempt fingerprints at overlay boundaries.
Describe PASS and mutation results as recorded assertions until independent replay binds actual returned artifacts; keep this distinct from kernel warrants.
Qualify append-only and source-commit claims by the exact checks performed.
remaining: Complete frontier_bundle dependency review and controls.
Review fixture/history semantics beyond the retained test selection; no campaign harvesting performed.
